provider_native_score_rule: Preserve the existing 05 multiscope aggregate unchanged as score_native_05 for history and audit.
stimes_effective_score_rule: Select the first scope in effective_scope_order containing evaluable cached evidence, then apply the v1_2 aggregation formula only to distinct logical units within that selected scope: 0.8*highest + 0.2*mean(up to 3 highest), capped at 100.
logical_unit_resolution: Prefer the provider-precomputed logical_unit when present. Fallback identity must include source_identifier before source_reference/source_url so distinct datasets or historical source versions are not collapsed.
conflict_rule: Preserve all conflicting evidence. Conflict is carried from explicit provider same_unit_conflict/taxon conflict state; different date, source dataset identity, scope or country is not itself a conflict. Within a true conflicting logical unit, use the precautionary maximum evaluable weighted assessment inherited from v1_2.

missingness.semantic_result: No evaluable scope produces null plus its explicit semantic state (UNKNOWN, TAXON_UNRESOLVED, SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED or equivalent).
missingness.replacement_rule: Replace the technical placeholder when valid information becomes available; recalculate and preserve history/provenance.

reliability: Keep separate. No invented weight model; coverage/component state may be reported even when a final reliability percentage is undefined.
precedence_resolution: This policy supersedes the stale AMENAZA.INCOMPAT.001/002 presentation behavior in amenaza-v1.contract.json for current executions; it does not rewrite the historical provider model or evidence. Historical contract remains preserved.
implementation_patch: 1.1.1 fixes logical-unit key preservation and exposes the authorized technical zero projection without changing scoring semantics.
